description: II-11 through the ACE OLE DB provider (ANSI-92 route), where DAO refuses CHECK with 3289. A DAO-built scratch database T(ID primary key, V LONG) with V = 5, 15, 25 is opened by ADO: ALTER TABLE ADD CONSTRAINT CK_V CHECK (V > 0); an INSERT with V = -1; ALTER TABLE ADD CONSTRAINT CK_V2 CHECK (V < 20) over the existing V = 25; an INSERT with V = 100; CREATE TABLE TC with a column-level CHECK and an INSERT violating it. Then DAO reopens: TableDef/Field ValidationRule and ValidationText of T and TC, and a DAO INSERT with V = -1. Asks whether CHECK is accepted, enforced, validated against existing rows and visible to DAO as a rule.
retentionNote: Designed r-q-cat-txn-lock probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
